subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should the repository accept this coordinated set of action-runtime updates in credential-bearing, scanning, agent, and release workflows after the exact rebased head completes targeted workflow validation?
rationale: The visible patch is pin-only and upstream provenance is positive, but these third-party bundles execute inside trusted workflows with secrets and publishing authority, and several important paths are not exercised by normal pull-request CI.

options.title: Validate and approve the batch
options.body: Rebase, complete exact-head workflow sanity and representative trusted-path checks, inspect the Codex runtime contract, then approve the official immutable pins together.

options.title: Split sensitive action families
options.body: Separate Codex, credential-token, and Docker-release pins into smaller PRs if maintainers want independent rollout and rollback boundaries.

options.title: Pause the update
options.body: Keep the current pins until a maintainer can complete upstream source and trusted-workflow validation.

recommendation.title: Validate and approve the batch
recommendation.body: Rebase, complete exact-head workflow sanity and representative trusted-path checks, inspect the Codex runtime contract, then approve the official immutable pins together.
